dict.Bucățile se pot lua din toată poza (mai: Pieces can be taken from the whole picture (slower on large pictures)
dict.Calculează din nou, cu alte bucăți alese: Calculate again, with other pieces chosen
dict.Pensula care șterge verdele: din zona pe: The brush that erases the green: no pieces are taken from the area you drag over
dict.Pensula verde: zona peste care tragi dev: Green brush: the area you drag over becomes a source for the fill
dict.Roșu: zona care se umple. Verde: de unde: Red: the area that gets filled. Green: where the pieces are taken from. Drag with ＋ over what fits and with − over what you don't want to appear (Shift switches the brush on the spot). The result is shown on the right.
dict.Zona verde de la început: chenarul din j: The initial green area: the frame around the red area
dict.Zona verde e prea mică: pictează cu ＋ pe: The green area is too small: paint with ＋ over a part of the picture that looks like what should appear in place of the red.
dict.Umplere după conținut într-o fereastră:: Content-aware fill in a window: choose with the brush where the pieces are taken from and see the result before applying it
dict.Bucățile luate din altă parte primesc lu: Pieces taken from elsewhere get the brightness and color of the place where they land (good when the matching texture is darker, brighter or differently colored)
dict.Bucățile se pot lua și întoarse stânga-d: Pieces can also be taken flipped left-to-right (good for symmetric things: a face, a building, a leaf)
dict.Bucățile se pot lua și rotite cu 90, 180: Pieces can also be taken rotated by 90, 180 or 270 degrees (good for patterns that change direction: a curve, a circle, turned stripes)
dict.Bucățile se pot lua și mai mici sau mai: Pieces can also be taken smaller or larger (good when the same pattern appears nearer and farther: a floor, a fence, grass in perspective)
